title: Change of rings preserves all K-flat complexes with independent coefficient universe
statement: On a site essentially small in the coefficient universe, let R → S be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings and E an additive functor with the prescribed ordinary extension-of-scalars objects and morphisms [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For every K-flat cochain complex K [def-pc-kflat-complex], E(K) is K-flat. No flatness of the individual terms of K and no flatness of S over R is required.

proof.text: Restriction of scalars is faithful exact and preserves the direct sums in total complexes. The balanced tensor-cancellation isomorphism is natural in both module arguments. Extend it degreewise to double complexes and then to total complexes, checking both differential terms.

For acyclic L over S, its restriction is acyclic over R. K-flatness of K gives acyclicity of Tot(U(L) tensor_R K). The total cancellation isomorphism transfers this to the restriction of Tot(L tensor_S E(K)). Faithful exact restriction reflects acyclicity, which is precisely K-flatness of E(K).

theorem changeOfRings_isKFlat_independentCoefficients
    (E : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj S))
    (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = changeOfRings φ M)
    (hm : ∀ {M N} (g : M ⟶ N), E.map g =
      eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom φ M g ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [E.Additive]
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients K)
    : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
